standard.summary: 同时微调 CLIP 文本编码器。开启表示「UNet 与 TE 一起训」，关闭表示「只训 UNet、不训 TE」。
standard.effect: 启动路径把它翻成 network_train_unet_only 的相反值，并清掉 network_train_text_encoder_only，避免旧输入把语义翻转成「只训 TE」。anima 全参微调有单独分支：请求会转成显存的 TE 策略字段，而 network_train_unet_only 一律为真。
standard.whenToUse: 概念在文本里表达不出来、需要让 TE 跟着适应时；或全参微调想让 TE 也更新。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存紧张时——TE 的优化器状态会额外占一大块。数据集很小的时候打开容易过拟合到 caption 的措辞上。

standard_en.summary: Also fine-tune the CLIP text encoder. On means "train UNet and TE together"; off means "train UNet only, not the TE".
standard_en.effect: The launch path turns it into the negation of network_train_unet_only and clears network_train_text_encoder_only, so stale input cannot flip the meaning to "TE only". anima full fine-tuning has its own branch: the request becomes a stored TE policy field while network_train_unet_only is forced true.
standard_en.whenToUse: When a concept cannot be expressed in text and the TE has to adapt; or when a full fine-tune should update the TE too.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When VRAM is tight -- the TE optimizer state takes a sizeable extra block. On a very small dataset it tends to overfit to caption wording.

advanced.principle: TrainingRouteService.build_config_json 在通用分支里做 network_train_unet_only = not train_text_encoder，并 pop 掉 network_train_text_encoder_only；anima-finetune 走更早的分支，把请求折成 anima_full_finetune_train_text_encoder_requested 与 anima_full_finetune_text_encoder_policy，强制 network_train_unet_only=True 并把阶段标成 dit_only_cache_first。schema_default_inheritance 把它列进 NEVER_SKIP，因为它是「存在即改变行为」的键。
advanced.intervention: 请求归一化阶段的三个键改写，训练循环按这些键决定哪些参数参与反传。
advanced.expectedImpact: 开启后每步多一次 TE 前向与反传；收敛形态会变，caption 措辞的影响被放大。
advanced.tradeoffs: 这个键刻意不是 UnifiedTrainingConfig 字段，只在启动路径上存在；直接把裸键写进 config 文件不会生效，必须走路由归一化。

advanced_en.principle: TrainingRouteService.build_config_json sets network_train_unet_only = not train_text_encoder on the generic branch and pops network_train_text_encoder_only; anima-finetune takes an earlier branch that folds the request into anima_full_finetune_train_text_encoder_requested and anima_full_finetune_text_encoder_policy, forces network_train_unet_only=True and tags the phase dit_only_cache_first. schema_default_inheritance lists it in NEVER_SKIP because its presence alone changes behaviour.
advanced_en.intervention: Three key rewrites during request normalisation; the training loop reads those keys to decide which parameters receive gradients.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: On, every step gains one TE forward and backward; the convergence shape changes and caption wording matters more.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The key is deliberately not a UnifiedTrainingConfig field and only exists on the launch path, so writing the bare key into a config file does nothing -- it has to go through route normalisation.
